card.name: Tuljak
card.era: Music by Miina Harma 1897; dance by Anna Raudkats; at song celebrations from 1928, every Dance Celebration since 1934
card.tagline: Estonia's celebratory wedding dance and Dance Celebration finale.
card.profile: Tuljak is a popular Estonian couple dance of wedding-celebration character, telling the courting and wedding story of Tonn and Manni (All Around This World; Estonian Wikipedia). The choral song 'Tuljak' was composed by Miina Harma in 1897 as an arrangement of several folk melodies, with lyrics by Karl Ferdinand Karlson; Anna Raudkats created the accompanying dance, which draws on the Viru waltz and older dances (Estonian Music Information Centre; Miina Harma Gumnaasium). The traditional dance-tale of courtship was traced to Slavonic dances; the choreographed Tuljak has been the grand finale of every Estonian Dance Celebration, accompanied by choir and orchestra.
card.insight: 'Tuljak' has been played at every dance and song celebration since 1934 and is so emblematic that Estonians compare it to the anthem-like 'Mu isamaa on minu arm' (ERR).
card.image_significance: The Dance Festival's wedding anthem. A representative image shows folk dress and patterned partner or group figures — Estonia.
